title: SCN-9: the ask sits past character 1,000 of a long recap message
storyline: 03-scanner-quality.md SCN-9 (asks past character 1000 are lost at ingest), placeholders

sources.body: Thanks for the time today, this was really helpful for the whole team. Quick recap so we are all aligned before the board review next week. On scope: we agreed the POC covers member services only, with claims status and benefits questions as the two intents, and the handoff to a human rep with the case summary. Provider services stays out of scope until the second phase, and the pharmacy questions go to the existing IVR for now. On data: the claims warehouse feeds Data 360 nightly in batch for the POC, with a target of near real time in production; the member profile is unified on the member id, and the test members are synthetic. On security: SSO through the IdP for staff users only, no real member data in the POC org, and the vendor questionnaire comes from infosec by the 24th. On timeline: build in two sprints, demo to the contact-center leads in week three, board review in week four. On success criteria: containment of at least 40 percent on the two intents, average handle time down for the handed-off cases, and no wrong answers on claim status in the scripted tests. Last thing: can you send me the security whitepaper for the Data 360 connector by Thursday? Our CISO wants to read it before the board review.
